outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart of Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models (RPR2, RPM, SNL, LP, SL, KP) showing mean ± SD, with individual data points overlaid as colored dots (red/blue/orange) on each bar, representing the biological replicates.
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating the experimental workflow (intratracheal Ad-Cre administration, MRI imaging, sacrifice/H&E), not a data plot.
Panel C shows representative MRI photographic images of tumors, not a quantitative plot.
Panel D shows representative H&E micrograph images of lung tissue, not a data plot.
Panel E shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrograph images, not a quantitative plot with averaged data.
Panel F shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrograph images (zoom-in), not a quantitative plot.
Panel G shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrograph images with annotations, not a quantitative plot.
